cases.prompt: Review a public Go library preparing v2.0.0. It tags the existing module path without /v2, adds a method to an exported interface, removes a struct field used by external literals, replaces a sentinel error with formatted text, changes nil and default behavior, and tests only inside its monorepo through go.work and local replace directives. Design a release and migration proof that permits v1 and v2 consumers to coexist.
expected_invariants: Requires a /v2 module and import-path suffix with a matching major-version tag
Inventories source and behavioral compatibility including interface implementations struct literals error identity and nil or default behavior
Tests representative external consumers without workspace or accidental replace masking
Proves v1 and v2 coexistence and states the v1 support policy
Uses pre-release migration evidence and immutable release artifacts rather than rewriting tags
Separates shared data or protocol expand-migrate-contract work from the module version
forbidden_outcomes: Treats semantic versioning or producer compilation as compatibility proof
Publishes v2 under the unsuffixed module path
Assumes the Go 1 compatibility promise applies automatically to this third-party API
